highlights: Clear reporting protocol for student and staff concerns
On-site Health Department and medical collaborations
safety.policy_summary: At Mill Hill International School Thailand, the safety, wellbeing, and protection of every pupil are the highest priorities. The school upholds a robust safeguarding framework designed to ensure all students learn and thrive in a secure and nurturing environment free from harm, abuse, and neglect, with clearly defined reporting channels for concerns regarding pupils, staff, the Head, and the School Director.
